description: This file defines the ThemeViewLocationExpanderProvider class, which implements IViewLocationExpanderProvider to customize view location expansion based on themes in an OrchardCore application.

classes.name: ThemeViewLocationExpanderProvider
classes.description: Implements view location expansion logic based on themes for OrchardCore.

methods.name: ThemeViewLocationExpanderProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing environment and extension manager dependencies.

methods.name: PopulateValues
methods.description: Populates the theme value in the view location context based on current HTTP context theme.

methods.name: ExpandViewLocations
methods.description: Expands view locations based on theme hierarchy and context, adding theme-specific paths.
